modules.lip-extraction.live_lip_extracti: Live lip extraction uses Face Landmarker; equivalence to V2 FaceMesh has not been verified. Mirroring and face magnification affect display only. High frame rate is a device request; use the actual file as evidence. Recording buffer limit is 128 MB; live parameters are limited to 32 MB. Encoder-start estimates, device latency, and filter lag can all cause offsets. Check against known synchronization events. Offset adjustment shifts lip data only, leaving audio and original video unchanged.

modules.lip-extraction.only_this_view_is: Only this view is normalized by each parameter's range; original values are retained. Voice onset and lip movement have physiological timing differences. Similar curves alone cannot prove device synchronization.
